control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting ELEC-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 14 May 2026 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
